paras.text: [latubʿathunna] You will certainly be raised again after death.

[latuhasabunna] Your account will certainly be taken.

So worship your Lord, and offer your five daily prayers, and keep the fasts of your month (Ramadan), and pay the zakat of your wealth with willing hearts, and perform the Hajj of the House of your Lord, and obey your rulers; you will enter the Paradise of your Lord.

Commentary: In this sermon Huzoor ﷺ made his family aware about the Hereafter. We see these features in this sermon.

1. Brevity

2. Easy words

3. Simile: death has been likened to sleep and coming alive again to waking.

4. Style of emphasis: to stress his point he ﷺ adopted the style of emphasis — you will certainly die, etc.

He ﷺ established the custom of praise and glorification at the beginning of the sermon.

The Farewell Sermon

يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّهٗ لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدِيْ وَلَآ اُمَّةَ بَعْدَكُمْ ۞ اَلَا فَاعْبُدُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ۞ وَصَلُّوْا خَمْسَكُمْ ۞ وَصُوْمُوْا شَهْرَكُمْ وَاَدُّوْا زَكٰوةَ اَمْوَالِكُمْ طَيِّبَةً بِهَا اَنْفُسُكُمْ ۞ وَتَحُجُّوْنَ بَيْتَ رَبِّكُمْ ۞ وَاَطِيْعُوْا وُلَاةَ اَمْرِكُمْ ۞ تَدْخُلُوْا جَنَّةَ رَبِّكُمْ

Translation: O people! There is no prophet after me, nor will any Ummah be born after you. Beware! So worship your Lord, and offer your five daily prayers, and keep the fasts of your month (Ramadan), and pay the zakat of your wealth with willing hearts, and perform the Hajj of the House of your Lord, and obey your rulers; you will enter the Paradise of your Lord.

(Ibn Jarir, Ibn 'Asakir from Abu Umamah)

paras.text: Translation: O servants of Allah! I enjoin upon you the taqwa of Allah, and urge you to His obedience. O people! Indeed your blood and your property, till meeting your Lord, are unlawful in the same way as the sanctity of this day of today in this month of today and this city of today. Whoever has a trust with him, let him return it to the one who entrusted it to him; and indeed the interest of the Ignorance has ended, and I begin with the interest of my uncle Abbas bin Abd al-Muttalib. The blood-claims of the Ignorance have ended, and first of all I begin with the blood of Amir bin Rabi'ah bin Harith bin Abd al-Muttalib.

اُوْصِيْكُمْ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِ بِتَقْوَى اللّٰهِ وَاَحُثُّكُمْ عَلٰى طَاعَتِهٖ ۞ اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّ دِمَآءَكُمْ وَاَمْوَالَكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ حَرَامٌ اِلٰٓى اَنْ تَلْقَوْا رَبَّكُمْ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا فِيْ شَهْرِكُمْ هٰذَا فِيْ بَلَدِكُمْ هٰذَا فَمَنْ كَانَتْ عِنْدَهٗ اَمَانَةٌ فَلْيُؤَدِّهَا اِلَى الَّذِي ائْتَمَنَهٗ عَلَيْهَا وَاِنَّ رِبَا الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَوْضُوْعٌ وَّاِنَّ اَوَّلَ رِبًا اَبْدَاُ بِهٖ رِبَا عَمِّي الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَاِنَّ دِمَآءَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَوْضُوْعَةٌ وَّاِنَّ اَوَّلَ دَمٍ اَبْدَاُ بِهٖ دَمُ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيْعَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ (سنن ابی داؤد: ۳۳۳۴)

Translation: O servants of Allah! I enjoin upon you the taqwa of Allah, and urge you to His obedience. O people! Indeed your blood and your property, till meeting your Lord, are unlawful in the same way as the sanctity of this day of today in this month of today and this city of today. Whoever has a trust with him, let him return it to the one who entrusted it to him; and indeed the interest of the Ignorance has ended, and I begin with the interest of my uncle Abbas bin Abd al-Muttalib. The blood-claims of the Ignorance have ended, and first of all I begin with the blood of Amir bin Rabi'ah bin Harith bin Abd al-Muttalib.

Difficult words and meanings:

[usikum] I enjoin upon you.

[talqaw] You meet.

[ahuththukum] I urge you.

[shahr] Month.

[dima'] Plural of dam: blood.

[fal-yu'addiha] So let him return it.

Commentary: This extract has been taken from the Farewell Sermon. The following features are found in this sermon.

1. Simplicity of words.

2. Simile: the sanctity of human blood and property has been likened to the sanctity of the day of 'Arafah, the month of Dhul-Hijjah and Makkah al-Mu'azzamah.

3. By the use of inna emphasis was created in the speech.

4. Unfamiliar and difficult words were avoided. This is a masterpiece of Arabic language and literature.

5. The statement of the basic belief, that is, the finality of prophethood, and of the duties with brevity and comprehensiveness, which is the best example of the characteristic of him ﷺ, jawami' al-kalim (comprehensive speech).

Translation: O servants of Allah! I enjoin upon you the taqwa of Allah, and urge you to His obedience. O people! Indeed your blood and your property, till meeting your Lord, are unlawful in the same way as the sanctity of this day of today in this month of today and this city of today. Whoever has a trust with him, let him return it to the one who entrusted it to him; and indeed the interest of the Ignorance has ended, and I begin with the interest of my uncle Abbas bin Abd al-Muttalib. The blood-claims of the Ignorance have ended, and first of all I begin with the blood of Amir bin Rabi'ah bin Harith bin Abd al-Muttalib.

Difficult words and meanings:

[usikum] I enjoin upon you.

[talqaw] You meet.

[ahuththukum] I urge you.

[shahr] Month.

[dima'] Plural of dam: blood.

[fal-yu'addiha] So let him return it.

Commentary: This extract has been taken from the Farewell Sermon. The following features are found in this sermon.

1. Simplicity of words.

2. Simile: the sanctity of human blood and property has been likened to the sanctity of the day of 'Arafah, the month of Dhul-Hijjah and Makkah al-Mu'azzamah.

3. By the use of inna emphasis was created in the speech.

4. Unfamiliar and difficult words were avoided. This is a masterpiece of Arabic language and literature.

5. The statement of the basic belief, that is, the finality of prophethood, and of the duties with brevity and comprehensiveness, which is the best example of the characteristic of him ﷺ, jawami' al-kalim (comprehensive speech).

ترجمہ: اے اللہ کے بندو! میں تمہیں اللہ کے تقویٰ کی وصیت کرتا ہوں اور تمہیں اس کی اطاعت کی ترغیب دیتا ہوں۔ اے لوگو! بے شک تمہارے خون اور تمہارے مال تمہارے رب سے ملاقات تک اسی طرح حرام ہیں جیسے آج کے دن، آج کے مہینے اور آج کے شہر کی حرمت ہے۔ جس کے پاس امانت ہو تو وہ اس کو لوٹا دے جس نے اس کو امانت دی اور بے شک جاہلیت کا سود ختم ہے اور میں اپنے چچا عباس بن عبدالمطلب کے سود سے ابتداء کرتا ہوں۔ جاہلیت کے خون ختم ہیں اور سب سے پہلے میں عامر بن ربیعہ بن حارث بن عبدالمطلب کے خون سے ابتداء کرتا ہوں۔

مشکل الفاظ اور معنی:

[اُوْصِيْكُمْ] میں تمہیں وصیت کرتا ہوں۔

[تَلْقَوْا] تم ملو

[اَحُثُّكُمْ] میں تمہیں ترغیب دیتا ہوں۔

[شَهْر] مہینہ

[دِمَآء] دم کی جمع خون

[فَلْيُؤَدِّهَا] پس اسے ادا کرے

تبصرہ: یہ اقتباس خطبۂ حجۃ الوداع سے لیا گیا ہے۔ اس خطبے میں درج ذیل خصوصیات پائی جاتی ہیں۔

۱۔ الفاظ کی سادگی۔

۲۔ تشبیہ: انسانی خون اور مال کی حرمت کو عرفہ کے دن اور ذی الحجہ کے مہینے اور مکہ معظمہ کی حرمت سے تشبیہ دی۔

۳۔ اِنَّ کے استعمال سے کلام میں تاکید پیدا کی۔

۴۔ نامانوس اور مشکل الفاظ سے اجتناب کیا۔ یہ عربی زبان و ادب کا شاہکار ہے۔

۵۔ اساسی عقیدہ یعنی ختم نبوت اور فرائض کا اختصار اور جامعیت سے بیان جو کہ آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم کی خصوصیت جوامع الکلم کا بہترین نمونہ ہے۔
